stories.title: Flint Mountain FC granted voluntary relegation from Cymru North and change name to FC Mountain
stories.summary: Flint Mountain Football Club has voluntarily dropped two tiers in the Welsh football pyramid and renamed itself FC Mountain with immediate effect. stories.title: Indoor darts venue with shop and spectator gallery planned for Connah’s Quay industrial unit
stories.summary: An industrial unit on Dock Road in Connah’s Quay could become an indoor darts venue under plans filed with Flintshire council. The application proposes converting part of a vacant unit at 1A Dock Road Industrial Estate into a leisure facility, with the remainder of the building staying as a separate industrial unit. stories.summary: Greenfield Valley Trust is celebrating the “beating heart” of the historic site as part of National Volunteers’ Week – while encouraging more local people to get involved in shaping its future. stories.title: Connah’s Quay Central by-election triggered as Bernie Attridge quits Flintshire Council
stories.summary: A by-election will be held in Connah’s Quay Central after Bernie Attridge resigned as a councillor on Monday, bringing to an end more than two decades on Flintshire County Council.
